description:
TPO 283 T7 Ash, pollard up to 4m. 

Conservation Uxbridge Moor
1x Ash to cut back overhanging situated in rear of no.8 at Lambourne Court, St Johns Close.
decision_conditions: Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981:  Note that it is an offence under this act to disturb roosting bats, nesting birds or any other protected species.  Therefore, if applicable, it is advisable to consult your tree surgeon / consultant to agree an acceptable time for carrying out the approved works.

Statutory crown lifting of trees: This does not require formal consent of the Council if the clearance only involves the removal of branches to give a separation between the footway and the tips of the lowest branches by up to 2.3m or the carriageway by up to 5.2m.
Owner(s)'s permission:  Permission should be sought from the owner(s) of the tree(s) and / or the owner(s) of the land that the tree(s) overhang prior to any approved work being carried out.
The early mature Ash tree is situated at the front of the property. It is in a fair condition and can be seen by neighbours, road and footpath users. For these reasons, it has a high amenity value.

Reducing an 8m tree by 4m is extensive pruning and would dramatically lower the amenity of the tree. The species of tree could react badly to such pruning and have future issues because of it, again lowering the amenity. The lifespan of the tree could also be lowered with excessive pruning.
The specification of work is not accepted.
The second tree on this application is part of a conservation area and not under the TPO. We will not be adding this tree to the TPO and work is accepted.
